thread:
marta: Heads-up — another onboarding hiccup today. Sample app showed an empty tool result when auth retry happened mid-stream. Different from earlier reports: this one had a trailing null byte and extra whitespace inside the tool args string, so our simple JSON.parse fallback choked.

sam: Oof. Can you paste the exact logged chunk?

marta: Logged right after the retry replay: 

```
{"tool_call": {"name": "search_docs", "args": "{\"q\": \"release notes\", \"filters\": []}\\u0000  "}}
```

Note the \u0000 at the end plus two spaces. Our previous helper change attempted JSON.parse for string args and then a single-quote -> double-quote normalize. That doesn't handle trailing control chars.

tuan: That explains why unit tests passed but demo failed. Streaming retries can re-emit chunk buffers with padding or control bytes depending on how the underlying stream was cached.

olga: Python SDK had a stricter normalizer that trims whitespace and strips null bytes before parse; that's why py parity didn't show this. Node needs a similar canonicalizer.

sam: Proposed minimal-normalizer in core transport: when a field expected-by-schema-to-be-object arrives as a string, run: strip nulls, trim, attempt JSON.parse, if fail, attempt lenient fixes (single->double quotes), else return original string and emit debug telemetry event. Keep it opt-out via SDK config flag (strictStructuredParsing: true by default). Thoughts?

marta: I like opt-out, but default should be strict (parse & normalize) for onboarding DX. Also record a telemetry bool that indicates normalization happened so we can quantify how often we're patching responses vs surface bug in transport.

tuan: We should avoid doing heavy transforms in hot path. The normalizer must be tiny: strip control chars (\\u0000), trim, then JSON.parse. Only if parse fails call a slower fallback and mark it in telemetry.

sam: Agreed. Keep the fast path cheap. The slow path (quote normalization) can be gated behind a debug flag for now. We'll flip it off after we fix the transport replay.

olga: Add a cross-SDK parity test: sample-app harness that simulates the following sequence — chunk with partial payload -> 401 -> retry replay with padded nulls/whitespace -> final chunk. Assert SDK-normalized tool_call.args equals parsed object. We'll add this to both node and python CI.

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-1301: "transport: structured-response normalizer for node; telemetry for parse fixes" and attached sample-app failing trace.

marta: Short-term I pushed helper update to be more defensive: remove control chars before JSON.parse and try one-round trim. Unit tests added. But we should land transport-level fix quickly.

sam: I'll pick up DEVEX-1301. Plan: (1) implement fast normalizer in transport boundary (strip control chars + trim + JSON.parse) with debug telemetry, (2) add opt-out flag strictStructuredParsing in SDK config and expose in onboarding docs, (3) add cross-SDK sample-app test (tuan), (4) remove long-tail helpers once transport guarantee is in place.

tuan: I'll add the cross-SDK test harness and make it part of the sample-app integration suite. Will mark it flaky until we land the transport change, then flip to required.

olga: Also add a short note in SDK README explaining the guarantee: "tool args will be returned as parsed objects in structured/jsonMode when strictStructuredParsing is enabled". That should help reduce future confusion from sample app developers.

marta: One more thing — add a regression unit test that includes weird inputs: trailing \\u0000, embedded tabs/newlines, and single-quoted strings so we don't regress. I pushed a draft test for that in the helper PR.

sam: Good. If transport fix is small we'll remove helper heuristics entirely; until then keep the helper guard as last-resort. Also add a debug log that includes sanitized preview (max 200 chars) when normalization happens to help debug. Make sure we redact PII.

ci-bot: DEVEX-1301 status: open -> in progress. PR template attached.

olga: After node normalizer is in, I'll coordinate a parity dance to ensure py/node both expose the same config option and tests.

marta: TL;DR: onboarding blank caused by trailing null/whitespace in stringified tool args after auth retry streaming. Temporary helper guard hardened; transport-level fast normalizer + telemetry planned; cross-SDK tests to follow.

sam: Thanks for the detailed repro, Marta. This one was tricky but we have a clear mitigation plan. :thumbsup:
